title: DOW-UAP-D078, Notional Map: Western United States Event
doc_notes: This document is a notional map and summary of UAP incidents reported by federal law enforcement agents in October 2023, noting that the images are artificially generated for illustrative purposes.

incidents.summary: Agents reported observing a large fiery orb projected against a ridgeline.
Agents reported observing a dark kite-shaped object with red and white lights.
Agents reported observing a translucent kite-shaped object.
